svg.title: Вращение плеч с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Shoulder pass-through with a long elastic resistance band held wide in both hands. LEFT standing upright with arms straight down in front, band taut horizontally across front of thighs. RIGHT both straight arms lifted overhead holding same flexible band taut horizontally, hands still wide. Unattached band, no wall, post, rod or cable machine. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
